text:
Dear Sir or Madam

Please find attached my employment contract with Weidgrund Holdings Ltd in Emmen.

On 19 January 2026 Hannah Schneider, the head of administration, called me in and told me I was dismissed with immediate effect. I had to pack my things and leave the same afternoon. There was no notice period and no warning beforehand.

Two days later, on 21 January, I wrote to Ms Schneider by e-mail and asked her to give me the reasons for this dismissal in writing. I want to see on paper why they think they could do this.

The contract I had was a fixed one. I started on 5 May 2022 and it was agreed to run until 4 May 2026, because I was hired for a four-year project. That end date is in the contract.

Whether I've earned anything since is honestly hard to say. At the end of January I did a translation for a former client, Mark Huber, and sent him an invoice for CHF 945. He now says the translation wasn't what he ordered and he won't pay it, at least not in full. We are still arguing about it, so I might get the money or I might get nothing.

I've also attached my last pay slip, which shows my salary of CHF 1,430 a month for my part-time post.

I would like to know what I can claim for the months up to May.

Yours faithfully
Nina Tanner
Kirchgasse 36, Emmen
